business_brief.industry: AI-powered website builder and digital growth system for SMBs
target_audience: service businesses (lawyers, dentists, clinics, real estate)
offers: Trust-first CRO and WhatsApp-first lead capture

brand_strategy.positioning: Focus AI is the AI-powered digital growth system designed specifically for Israeli SMBs and service businesses, delivering high-converting, multilingual websites optimized for local lead generation and direct client engagement via WhatsApp.
brand_strategy.value_proposition: For Israeli SMBs and service professionals, Focus AI provides a fast, integrated solution to launch a professionally designed, multilingual website that attracts local customers and converts visitors into direct WhatsApp leads, simplifying your digital growth.

pains: Struggling to get online or update an outdated website
Difficulty attracting new local customers online
Lack of time and technical skills to manage digital marketing
High costs associated with website development and agencies
Ineffective lead generation channels for local business
desired_outcomes: A professional, modern website quickly and affordably
Increased visibility and inquiries from local customers
Easy-to-manage online presence without technical hassle
Reliable system for generating direct leads
Effective communication channel with potential clients
decision_criteria: Ease of use and fast setup
Ability to generate tangible business leads (e.g., WhatsApp inquiries)
Relevance to the Israeli market and language support (EN/HE/AR)
top_objections: AI websites are generic and won't stand out
I don't have the technical skills to manage a website
It's too expensive compared to DIY options
Will it actually bring me customers?

differentiators.statement: Hyper-local focus for the Israeli market
differentiators.notes: Specific examples of Israeli businesses achieving success, mention of local team.
Show the ease of managing content across languages and conversion features.

differentiators.statement: Unique WhatsApp-first lead capture for direct client engagement
differentiators.notes: Highlight how the system funnels leads directly to WhatsApp, a preferred local channel.

differentiators.statement: A complete 'digital growth system' tailored for SMBs, not just a website builder
differentiators.notes: Explain integrated features beyond site building, e.g., local SEO tools, analytics for growth.

differentiators.statement: Fast launch with AI-assisted setup without technical jargon
differentiators.notes: Emphasize speed and simplicity of setup, showing the AI's role in a few clear steps.

tone.do: Use clear, benefit-led language. Address SMB challenges directly. Sound knowledgeable and empowering.
tone.avoid: Overly technical jargon, marketing hype, casual language, sounding generic or global.

voice_rules.rule: Prioritize direct benefits and outcomes for local SMBs.

example_do.en: Attract more local clients and grow your business with a website built for conversions.
example_do.he: משוך יותר לקוחות מקומיים והגדל את העסק שלך עם אתר שנבנה להמרות.
example_do.ar: اجذب المزيد من العملاء المحليين ونمي عملك من خلال موقع ويب مصمم للتحويلات.

example_dont.en: Our AI-powered platform leverages cutting-edge algorithms for optimized digital footprint.
example_dont.he: הפלטפורמה המונעת ב-AI שלנו ממנפת אלגוריתמים מתקדמים לטביעת רגל דיגיטלית אופטימלית.
example_dont.ar: تستخدم منصتنا المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي خوارزميات متطورة لبصمة رقمية محسنة.

voice_rules.rule: Emphasize simplicity and speed for non-technical users.

example_do.en: Launch your professional website in days, not months, with AI-guided setup.
example_do.he: הפעל את האתר המקצועי שלך תוך ימים, לא חודשים, עם הגדרה מודרכת AI.
example_do.ar: أطلق موقعك الاحترافي في أيام، وليس أشهر، بإعداد موجه بالذكاء الاصطناعي.

example_dont.en: Leverage our robust CMS and intuitive drag-and-drop interface for seamless content management.
example_dont.he: השתמש במערכת ניהול התוכן החזקה ובממשק הגרירה והשחרור האינטואיטיבי שלנו לניהול תוכן חלק.
example_dont.ar: استفد من نظام إدارة المحتوى القوي وواجهة السحب والإفلات البديهية لإدارة محتوى سلسة.

voice_rules.rule: Highlight the 'WhatsApp-first' and multilingual advantages as core features.

example_do.en: Connect directly with customers via WhatsApp from your multilingual website.
example_do.he: התחבר ישירות ללקוחות בוואטסאפ דרך האתר הרב-לשוני שלך.
example_do.ar: تواصل مباشرة مع العملاء عبر الواتساب من موقعك الإلكتروني متعدد اللغات.

example_dont.en: We offer integrated messaging solutions and localization options.
example_dont.he: אנו מציעים פתרונות מסרים משולבים ואפשרויות לוקליזציה.
example_dont.ar: نحن نقدم حلول مراسلة متكاملة وخيارات توطين.

key_points: Specifically designed to help Israeli SMBs attract and convert local customers.
Generate direct, qualified leads through WhatsApp, a preferred local communication channel.
Enhance your local online presence and visibility for greater impact.
Build a high-converting website seamlessly in English, Hebrew, and Arabic.
Reach a broader audience and serve diverse client needs across Israel.
Manage all language versions easily without complex manual translation.
Launch a professional, modern website rapidly with intuitive AI guidance.
No technical skills required; Focus AI handles the complexities.
Free up your time to focus on your business, not website management.
Websites built with conversion rate optimization (CRO) best practices.
Integrate clear trust signals to build credibility with your audience.
Designed to turn visitors into valuable inquiries and clients.

what_to_show: Testimonials from local Israeli businesses with names, photos, and specific results.
Examples of websites built for Israeli businesses (e.g., in Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, Haifa).
Case studies detailing specific growth/lead generation results for SMBs.
Quantifiable metrics (e.g., 'X% increase in WhatsApp inquiries', 'Y new leads per month').
Clear steps of the AI-assisted setup process.
Description of how the WhatsApp integration works end-to-end.
Explaining the multilingual content management workflow.
Logos of well-known Israeli SMBs or service professionals using the platform (if applicable and permission granted).

objections_and_responses.objection: AI websites are generic and won't stand out or reflect my unique business.
objections_and_responses.response_angle: Focus AI is tailored for the Israeli market and offers customization, not generic templates.

objections_and_responses.objection: I don't have the technical skills or time to build and manage a website.
objections_and_responses.response_angle: Our AI-guided system is designed for non-technical users, ensuring fast and easy setup and management.

objections_and_responses.objection: Will this actually bring me customers and leads?
objections_and_responses.response_angle: Focus AI is a digital growth system built for conversions, with WhatsApp-first lead capture to drive direct client engagement.

objections_and_responses.objection: It's too expensive, or I can get a cheaper website elsewhere.
objections_and_responses.response_angle: Focus AI offers a comprehensive, high-converting digital growth system specific to your market, providing greater value and ROI than basic builders.

objections_and_responses.objection: How reliable and secure is the platform?
objections_and_responses.response_angle: We provide a robust, secure, and reliable platform, ensuring your business's online presence is always professional and protected.

primary.action: Initiate a direct WhatsApp conversation with sales/support.

secondary.action: View a demo or process overview of the platform.

allowed: AI-powered website building for local businesses
restricted: Being the 'best' or 'number one' AI builder globally without specific proof

en: Focus on clear, benefit-led language that highlights efficiency and lead generation.
Emphasize the 'digital growth system' aspect to convey comprehensive value.
he: Maintain a professional and concise tone, avoiding exaggeration.
Highlight the relevance of WhatsApp as a primary business communication tool in Israel.
Emphasize ease of use and local market understanding.
Ensure RTL (Right-To-Left) support is visibly part of the offering.
ar: Adopt a respectful, confident, and outcome-focused tone.
Stress the practical outcomes for business owners, like increased leads and efficiency.
Clearly communicate the benefit of integrated Arabic language support for reaching a wider customer base.
Ensure RTL (Right-To-Left) support is visibly part of the offering.
